title: The Male teacher of the school
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：male　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 male 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the painter wrote of ① a male teacher of the school in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② so male that nobody in the studio would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the male ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the male teacher of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too male to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the male ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a male deer in the wood, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as male as the deer in the wood they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was male or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something male, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite male; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the male ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, in silence, she wrote of another male teacher of the school in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less male than anybody had expected. ⑩ The male deer in the wood that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the male ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 男性（前置定语 a male teacher of the school：1955 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件男性的男教师）
B. adj. 男性／雄（两处加强说法：so male that … 与 no less male than …）
C. adj. 男性／雄（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 男性（表语 too male to do：母亲觉得它太男性，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 雄（前置定语 a male deer in the wood：叔叔把整件事称作一桩雄的鹿）
F. adj. 雄（同级比较 as male as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩林子里的雄鹿相比）
G. adj. 雄（后置定语 something male：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 雄（受程度副词修饰 quite male：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a male teacher of the school
the male teacher of the school that
a male deer in the wood
The male deer in the wood that

answers.why: male 意为“男性”，1955 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件男性的男教师”，此处作前置定语 a male teacher of the school。
male 意为“男性”，此处用 so male that 结构，说它男性到画室里没人敢靠近。
male 意为“男性”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的男性学校的男教师，等于最高级的说法。
male 意为“男性”，母亲认为这件东西“太男性了，谁也用不上”，too male to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
male 意为“雄”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩雄的鹿”，此处作前置定语 a male deer in the wood。
male 意为“雄”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩林子里的雄鹿一样雄”，同级比较用 as male as。
male 意为“雄”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“雄的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something male。
male 意为“雄”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当雄”，quite 修饰原级 male。
male 意为“雄”，no less male than 表示“其雄不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之雄不亚于任何人的预料。
male 意为“雄”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的雄鹿”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件男性的男教师。（a male teacher of the school）
它男性到画室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so male that …）
母亲觉得它太男性，谁也用不上。（too male to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩雄的鹿。（a male deer in the wood）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩林子里的雄鹿一样雄。（as male as …）
到了 1962 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件雄的东西。（something male）
answers: In 1955 the painter wrote of a male teacher of the school in the catalogue.
It was so male that nobody in the studio would go near it.
My mother thought it too male to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a male deer in the wood.
He said nobody would call it as male as the deer in the wood they had once had.
By 1962 the catalogue asked for nothing but something male.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 male 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the painter wrote of a male teacher of the school in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the male teacher of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too male to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a male deer in the wood, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite male, and everybody laughed.
The male ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
